name: Safe decoder diagnostics identify the failed decode without leaking host data

applicability.reason: Requires structured decoder diagnostics. Malformed JSON DOES raise JSONSyntaxError and the ExceptionContext carries it, but C036 additionally requires the decoder name, format version, byte or scalar offset, structural path and violated limit; the raised value carries the error symbol alone.

expect.status: The diagnostic identifies decoder and structural failure context without secret Host paths, pointers, addresses, or unrelated private data.
